[LSCP.1.6] A schema declaration carries its lifecycle on a
`scope` clause. The compiler must reject the unprefixed forms
`schema Foo logical:` and `schema Foo ttl <dur>:` with
`DS_VALIDATE_LEGACY_SCHEMA_LIFECYCLE`, naming the offending
form and suggesting the `scope` spelling. Bare `schema Foo:` is
unaffected — it means `scope explicit` ([LSCP.1.4]).
